subject: System Design
title: Message Queues
description: A quick, practical guide to Message Queues.

hook.text: You upload a video to YouTube. It takes minutes to process, but the upload response is instant.

buildup.text: A message queue accepts the task, stores it, and a background worker processes it later.

discovery.text: Kafka, RabbitMQ, and SQS decouple producers from consumers so neither has to wait for the other.

twist.text: If a worker crashes mid-task, the queue retries automatically. Messages survive failures.

climax.text: Message queues turn synchronous bottlenecks into asynchronous, resilient pipelines.

punchline.text: Don't wait — queue it and process later.

quiz.question: Why are message queues useful?
options: They decouple producers from consumers for async processing
